methodology: Fixed adversarial corpus with 40 near-topic distractors. Baseline and Hybrid use the supplied initial query; Corrective and Full execute the bounded P2 workflow. Generation corrective success means P3 corrected its seeded unsupported draft and the final verifier passed. Tokens are character-based estimates because the local provider exposes no billable usage.
